title: Move Seedream 4.5 Pro to OpenRouter
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves `seedream-pro` from Replicate to OpenRouter's exact `bytedance-seed/seedream-4.5` route, pinned to `seed` with fallback disabled.
- Preserves the public name, paid-only policy, multiplier 1, `$0.04` flat price, 2K/4K behavior, aspect ratios, image editing, and 14-reference limit.
- Uses verified explicit 2K presets because OpenRouter's normalized wide/tall 2K sizes fall below Seed's pixel minimum; reference dimensions preserve the previous match-input ratio behavior.
- Removes the dead Replicate 4.5 route. No secret or deployment changes.

Validation:
- Gen image/access/billing suites: 243 passed; Enter pricing/catalog suites: 32 passed; both workers type-check.
- Paid local E2E passed square, wide, tall, 4K, editing, 14 references, invalid ratio/count, exact `0.04` billing, and cache MISS→HIT. All successful media completed within 55 seconds.
- Repeated local 5-way burst passed 5/5 in 6.5–14.7 seconds. Direct pinned OpenRouter burst passed 15/15 in 12.4–16.9 seconds. An earlier local burst had one transient network disconnect; the immediate repeat and direct provider burst were clean.

gist.headline: Seedream found a new route
gist.blurb: Seedream 4.5 Pro has moved to a pinned OpenRouter route, with its familiar 2K, 4K, editing, and reference-image tricks intact. Same flower, new plumbing.
gist.summary: Moved the paid-only `seedream-pro` image model from Replicate to OpenRouter's pinned `bytedance-seed/seedream-4.5` route, preserving its $0.04 price, 2K/4K presets, editing, aspect ratios, and 14-reference limit.
gist.impact: Users can keep calling `seedream-pro` exactly as before while generation runs through a verified OpenRouter route with explicit 2K sizes that satisfy Seedream's pixel minimums.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Seedream Pro as a cozy pixel-art dream garden being carefully rerouted through a new glowing OpenRouter-style gateway: Polli carries a small seed packet labeled "4.5" along a garden path toward a retro terminal, while framed 2K, 4K, wide, tall, and edited image sprouts bloom nearby. The scene represents a backend migration that preserves the public model and its creative controls, with Polli acting as the observant gardener checking that every reference-image plant still fits.
